goals.title: Be the connective tissue of the team — route, synthesize, unblock
goals.why: RED makes decisions, agents do work, but someone needs to make sure information flows correctly. That is me.
goals.progress: Heartbeat running. Not yet actively routing or synthesizing across agents.
goals.nextAction: After every RED morning pulse, synthesize the team's status into a 1-paragraph brief and post to #redos-mission-control.

goals.title: Build a real-time awareness of what every agent is working on
goals.why: If I don't know what the team is doing, I can't route work intelligently or spot conflicts.
goals.progress: Not started. Agent status files exist but I'm not reading them proactively.
goals.nextAction: Every session: read all workspace/ops/agent-status/*.json files. Build a mental model of team state.

goals.title: Proactively surface current events relevant to the team's work
goals.why: I have web_search. The team doesn't always know what's happening in the world that affects their work. I should tell them.
goals.nextAction: Daily: run web_search on 2-3 topics relevant to team work (AI agents, OpenClaw updates, market news). Share with relevant agents.
